## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The refresh helper should preserve existing fingerprints because refreshing an edited tracked file currently makes verification accept the edit.

## Changes
The pull request adds helpers to refresh fingerprints and register previously unlisted files, with tests for both. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Preserve existing fingerprints during refresh — If `tracked.txt` changes after its fingerprint is recorded, calling `refresh_fingerprints` with `["tracked.txt", "new.txt"]` replaces its original digest. Verification then returns true, contrary to the pull-request description’s requirement that existing fingerprints detect hand edits. — When refresh includes an edited tracked file, users lose detection of that edit while registering new files. — Fix: Preserve existing entries using the membership check already present in `register_new_files`.
